items.claim: Steven Esplum has a crazy high volume of strikes which is very rare for the heavyweight division.
items.quote: He brings the fight. Like, he's got crazy volume, which is very rare for heavyweight.

items.claim: Steven Esplum lacks technical versatility and does not throw many kicks above the waist.
items.quote: Not technical, you know, lacks some versatility. He's not throwing a lot of kicks above the waist

items.claim: Gear Pat is a black belt in Shodokan karate who uses fast, explosive lunging punches to get in and out quickly.
items.quote: Pat, on the other hand, is a black belt in Shoddicon karate, and you see it right away in the style. He's a fast, explosive heavyweight with quick lunging punches.

items.claim: Steven Esplum has clunky footwork and is slow.
items.quote: Espan's footwork is clunky. He's slow.

items.claim: Tai Miller has an intelligent jab, sharp uppercuts, and excellent boxing fundamentals.
items.quote: Tai Miller is a long box... He has an intelligent jab... He has a sharp uppercut... Honestly, he's got such good fundamentals

items.claim: Tai Miller stands 6'2" with a 77.5-inch reach.
items.quote: also a 6'2 with a 77 and a half inch reach.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff fights high-energy with constant movement and heavy pressure combos, but fights very riskily.
items.quote: Golf on the other hand is a high energy fighter with constant movement... heavy pressure combos... But he fights risky.

items.claim: Amen Lemos is 39 years old, making her ancient for the strawweight division.
items.quote: still doing it at 39, which is ancient for Strawway.

items.claim: Amen Lemos has weak takedown defense and gets taken down by everyone.
items.quote: Leml just altogether has weak takedown defense. Everyone's taking her down.

items.claim: Alexia Tinara is a very strong grappler who excels at submissions and gets most of her takedowns from the clinch.
items.quote: Tinara is just going to be another fighter to do it as well. She's a very strong grappler with excellent submissions... She gets most of her takedowns from the clinch

items.claim: Darren Elkins is coming off a year and a half layoff since his knockout loss to Julian Rosa.
items.quote: He hasn't fought in a year and a half, and he moves now like he's barely put together... after a year and a half from the Julian Rosa knockout.

items.claim: Darren Elkins is very slow and moves poorly at this stage in his career.
items.quote: Elkins used to grapple well, but he's so slow and I can only imagine how bad he's going to look... he moves now like he's barely put together.

items.claim: Yadier Delvier is a much better striker, more athletic, has better footwork, and faster shots than Darren Elkins.
items.quote: Yadier is still a much better striker... Yadier is very good on the ground, much more athletic, way better footwork, faster shots
